notes: Grouped by contact as Grok Bot asked. Each mission: id, giver, setup (short phone lines), type (deliver/escort/kill/steal/race/heist), location, rewards.credits, choice (or null).

steps[] use the exact game.js QUESTS step schema (goto/collect/defeat/return/take/clean/race/escort, a/d or at:[dx,dz], r, limit, vehicle, wanted, item, wave). New step types/extras are listed per mission in engine_needs.
Missions with existing:true are already in game.js QUESTS under the same id; keep their ids and rewards.
Coordinates for new buildings/hubs are proposals (colony-local metres); adjust to the real layout.

side_jobs.title: Bounty: Dust Dealer
setup: Board: Saltblood runner, dead or alive.

dialogue.intro: Rusk: Alive pays more. Dead pays faster.
dialogue.success: Rusk: Bounty paid.
dialogue.fail: Rusk: He skipped. Again.

side_jobs.title: Corner Deal
setup: Buyer: You holding? Meet me.

dialogue.intro: Buyer: Quick. Security sweeps at the hour.
dialogue.success: Buyer: Pleasure.
dialogue.fail: Buyer: It’s a setup! Run!

side_jobs.notes: Contraband loop: each sale moves 1–3 units; 20% narc chance drops if you bought rumors.

side_jobs.title: Lab Under Siege
setup: Vesna: They’re hitting the lab. Now!

dialogue.intro: Vesna: Saltblood at the door. Get here.
dialogue.success: Vesna: Lab’s fine. Stock’s fine. You’re bleeding.
dialogue.fail: Vesna: They took the stock.

side_jobs.notes: Random cartel rival event when stock > 10 units.

side_jobs.title: Buy a Rumor
setup: Broker: 50 credits, I tell you a thing.

dialogue.intro: Broker: Information wants to be paid.
dialogue.success: Broker: Told you.
dialogue.fail: Broker: Rumors are rumors.

side_jobs.notes: Reveals a rare find (max HP/ammo), a stash or a hidden job on the radar.

side_jobs.title: Hire Muscle
setup: Brick: 200 a job. I don’t do stairs.
objectives: Hire Brick or one of his guys
They follow you for one mission

steps.text: Hire Brick or one of his guys
They follow you for one mission

dialogue.intro: Brick: Point. I punch.
dialogue.success: Brick: Good night. Tip’s optional. It isn’t.
dialogue.fail: Brick: I’m down. You owe me a medkit.

side_jobs.title: Car Meet
setup: Kestrel: Meet’s tonight. Bring a build.
objectives: Park your build at the meet

steps.text: Park your build at the meet

dialogue.intro: Kestrel: Show off. Lose politely.
dialogue.success: Kestrel: Crowd liked the spoiler.
dialogue.fail: Kestrel: Nobody liked the spoiler.

side_jobs.notes: Themed garages and car meets hook.

side_jobs.title: Frankie Smells Money
setup: Frankie: *snorts at the dirt, very insistent*

dialogue.intro: Frankie: *growls at a lump of regolith*
dialogue.success: Frankie: *proud snort*
dialogue.fail: Frankie: *sneezes, gives up*

fail_conditions: Someone else digs it up first
side_jobs.notes: Frankie already sniffs toward signals; reuse for buried cartel stashes.
